title: The Market Walk
logline: A granddaughter remembers how her grandmother walked to the Saturday market in Dessie, carrying more than goods—carrying the rhythm of home.
audience: Family in the diaspora and cousins who never saw Dessie's market at dawn.
intent: Feel closeness to grandmother's courage and ordinary beauty; understand that home is carried in small rituals.
style_block: warm grainy hand-painted look, soft golden-hour light, muted earth tones, gentle film grain, no text in image, consistent character face

character.name: Etye Almaz
character.description: Ethiopian grandmother in her sixties, grey-streaked hair wrapped in a soft white netela, kind tired eyes, weathered hands, simple cotton dress in deep ochre

music.caption: gentle instrumental underscore, soft krar-like plucked strings, warm pads, slow heartbeat rhythm, nostalgic and hopeful, no vocals, sparse melody under narration

cues.note: slight lift as market comes alive

end_card.text: Made with AI · The Market Walk

shots.reason: Establish place and hour before we meet her.
shots.image_prompt: Dawn over the hills of Dessie Ethiopia, quiet dirt road leading toward a distant market, soft mist, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle camera push-in, soft mist drifting, locked gentle motion
shots.narration: እሁድ ጥዋት፣ ደሴ ላይ፣ የገበያ መንገድ ይነሳል።
shots.narration_en: On a Sunday morning in Dessie, the road to market wakes first.

shots.reason: Introduce grandmother as the film's heart.
shots.image_prompt: Etye Almaz standing at her doorway wrapping a white netela, ochre dress, kind tired eyes, warm interior light
shots.motion_prompt: she slowly adjusts her shawl, camera holds steady, soft breeze
shots.narration: እቴ አልማዝ ጥዋት ላይ ቤቷን ትዘጋለች፣ ገበያ ትሄዳለች።
shots.narration_en: Etye Almaz closes her door at dawn and sets out for market.

shots.reason: Show the walk as ritual, not hardship alone.
shots.image_prompt: elderly Ethiopian woman walking a hillside path with a woven basket, eucalyptus trees, morning light on dust
shots.motion_prompt: slow tracking beside her steps, dust motes in light, gentle pace
shots.narration: መንገዱ ረጅም ነው፤ እግሮቿ ግን ምት ያውቃሉ።
shots.narration_en: The road is long, but her feet know the rhythm.

shots.reason: Intimate detail—hands that carry the story.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of weathered grandmother hands holding a woven basket handle, warm light, shallow depth of field
shots.motion_prompt: subtle handheld breath, fingers tighten gently on the basket
shots.narration: ቅርጫቷ ባዶ ትመስላለች፤ ቤተሰብ ግን ሙሉ ነው።
shots.narration_en: Her basket looks empty; her family is already full in it.

shots.reason: Arrive at the living market world.
shots.image_prompt: busy open-air market in Dessie, spice sacks, cloth stalls, soft crowd, golden morning, grandmother approaching from edge of frame
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan across stalls, gentle ambient motion, she enters frame calmly
shots.narration: ገበያው ድምፅ አለው—ቅመም፣ ሳቅ፣ የሕይወት ጫጫታ።
shots.narration_en: The market has a voice—spice, laughter, the noise of living.

shots.image_prompt: grandmother exchanging berbere spice with a market seller, both smiling softly, warm stall light
shots.motion_prompt: gentle push-in on their hands meeting, soft smile
shots.narration: ትደራደራለች፤ ግን የምትገዛው ምግብ ብቻ አይደለም።
shots.narration_en: She bargains, but she is buying more than food.

shots.image_prompt: grandmother resting under a shade tree with full basket, soft smile, late morning light
shots.motion_prompt: slow tilt up from basket to her face, leaves stir lightly
shots.narration_en: As my mother still says—the one who walks slowly does not finish empty.

shots.reason: Close on memory reaching the next generation.
shots.image_prompt: grandmother silhouetted on the road home at soft dusk, hills of Dessie behind her, warm afterglow
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back revealing the hills, she walks away calmly
shots.narration: እኔ አሁን በርቀት ነኝ፤ እርሷ ግን በእያንዳንዱ እርምጃ አሁንም ትመራለች።
shots.narration_en: I live far away now, but she still leads me—step by step.

shots.reason: Final feeling: inheritance as light, not only loss.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a small brass coffee cup and a folded netela on a wooden table, warm lamp light, quiet home interior
shots.motion_prompt: very slow Ken Burns style drift across the objects, intimate stillness
